Keep the original readonly/read-custody anchor or a separately qualified actual original-parent reopen capability through both-arm captures, inventories, receipts, seals and assembly. No path reconstruction, new root, renewed worker write authority or inherited-asset access is permitted. Removal/release occurs only in original H terminal cleanup after the full capture/assembly route no longer needs it, under the same E and original budgets.
DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure.ordering: Earlier whole-arm subtree observation and retained workspace identity observation -> DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure -> DevelopmentCompletion -> DevelopmentPairClosure -> P01-P17. DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure.producer: The same actual original H DevelopmentAttemptHandle, after original worker natural exit0, complete original whole-arm descendant/write closure and the existing stream/worker/backend closure requirements. DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure.source_constructor_and_inverse: Within the existing fixed DevelopmentOwner.finish_pair_backend_v1 lifecycle, retain the actual attempt-owned workspace-closure publication slot before observation/validation/I/O. relations.BackendAttemptTopology: Mandatory BACKEND_PAYLOAD_CONTRACT.attempt_identity_v3. Base first, child observations pin base, later source-owned snapshots pin base+previous; no observation pins its future snapshot. Exact all-consumer table required.
relations.BackendChildPayloads: All newly bound child Pins require exact closed bodies, parent/condition/attempt/nonce/ordinal equality and their actual fixed private producer. Wire decoding cannot create authority.
relations.CompleteBackendClosure: status=complete requires purpose=planned_protocol_shutdown, admission/initialization/server_identity/exit_observation/signal_observation/group_observation/socket_closure/stream_closure all nonnull, exit_code exactly integer0, pending_requests0, first_error null, forced_group_cleanup false and all captured requests complete. group_observation here proves only the actual server-owned subtree/threads has closed within the original arm group; it neither claims the still-live worker has exited nor that the entire arm group is empty. Exact same server attempt and original deadlines required. The later H finish_pair gate separately requires worker natural exit0 and full arm group/stream/workspace closure. Pins alone establish neither proof.
relations.CompleteExchange: status=complete requires started_ns/finished_ns/response nonnull, first_error null, request_complete=response_complete=known_closed, actual exact same source-owned request/admission/attempt and next ordinal; finished_ns>=started_ns within original deadlines. A failed initial clock cannot create a complete exchange. Unknown physical transfer counts/reservations persist; no retry and no inferred zero.
relations.Completion: A successful worker-produced BackendClosure certifies only the admitted server protocol. Failure cleanup remains permanently ineligible even if server exit_code0. H produces DevelopmentCompletion-v3 only later, after its actual independent worker natural exit0 and full original group/stream/workspace closure, joining the already captured BackendClosure. The worker never attests its own future exit.
relations.DeadlineDerivation: Let S be H-observed actual original worker start, D the unchanged MatchedSchedule.duration_ns, L the immutable launch latest_launch_ns+D bound and E the unchanged original evidence cutoff. Original Attempt.run_deadline R=S+D<=L<=common_cutoff<=original run deadline. WorkerLaunchAck carries S,R,E from that actual attempt. With positive selected initialization I and shutdown Q, require I+Q<D before either launch. Set generation_deadline G=R-Q, initialization_deadline J=min(S+I,G), shutdown_deadline R. BackendAttempt fields and H BackendAdmissionAck must equal these exact values. Initialization readiness <=J, H admission <G, every generation response finishes <=G, planned server shutdown and worker-owned closure/publication/natural exit finish <=R. H later evidence capture uses original E only. Checked original-clock integer arithmetic; no retry-based/readiness-based origin, added allowance or renewed clock.
relations.DevelopmentContractIdentity: The five constituent pins are exactly original DevelopmentContract.input_pins order [profile,policy,worker,whole,environment]. Full bytes of each earlier authenticated input remain authoritative; derived public/filtered objects are not substitutes. Pinning the profile also pins its backend/native/source/clock/source selection fields; no qualifier or object is inferred from a hash. No successful admission return and no PreparationHandle, pair nonce or arm filesystem effect. The existing actual parent retains the raw first and all failed/unknown publication/close effects; use the already selected postselection FailurePrefix/original-owner path when its required diagnostics can actually be captured. If failure publication also fails, retain actual private failure custody without a fabricated wire Pin. Do not emit PreparationFailure with a null, constituent, planned, computed-but-unpublished or future contract identity.
relations.FailureRepresentability: BackendClosure failed/unknown variants allow group/socket/stream/exit/admission/initialization observations to be null exactly when that operation did not return a complete captured observation; null never means closed. Exchange.started_ns may be null if the first clock observation failed, and finished_ns may be null independently. All raw first/secondary exceptions and live/unknown handles remain with the actual owner even if their diagnostic Pin cannot be published. DevelopmentFailure can retain null backend_attempt before a complete attempt snapshot exists; no missing snapshot implies no child.
relations.InitialSlots: Exactly one fresh slot with id0, selected n_ctx, speculative=false,is_processing=false; no id_task,params,next_token,n_prompt_tokens,n_prompt_tokens_processed,n_prompt_tokens_cache fields before any generation. Missing fields mean absent, not measured zero. Entire HTTP JSON and source/native freshness proof are required; these values alone grant no admission.
relations.Limits: 0<microbatch_tokens<=batch_tokens<=context_tokens; max requests<=8192; context and token capacity require selected model metadata compatibility and measured physical fit. Positive bounded n_predict is never a hard physical byte ceiling.
relations.PreparationFailure: prepare_pair_v2 returns actual PreparationOutcomeHandle. Before promotion, PreparationFailure covers every attempted prefix without requiring a future launch Pin. FailurePrefix is an optional second diagnostic publication, never a prerequisite to retaining the original error.
relations.Request: prompt_bytes equals actual UTF8 prompt length, bounded prompt plus full encoded request fits profile maximum_request_bytes; ordinal exactly next expected once-only generation ordinal; admission same actual handle; n_predict equals selected profile maximum_generated_tokens. No implicit zero token initialization probe. CompletionRequest-v2 serializes the fixed response_fields array in BACKEND_PAYLOAD_CONTRACT; it is not a caller field.
relations.Sampling: 0<=seed<=4294967294, never random sentinel; 0<=temperature_milli<=2000,0<=top_p_milli<=1000,0<=min_p_milli<=1000,0<=top_k<=context_tokens,0<repeat_penalty_milli<=4000. Request sampling equals profile exactly; fixed-point values serialize as exact 3-decimal JSON numbers. No per-request sampler/seed override.
relations.SchemaSelection: The four inherited v3 replacements remain effective. This successor additionally requires CompletionRequest-v2 and the exact child bindings in BACKEND_PAYLOAD_CONTRACT. No v1 request or v2 development fallback. V3 requires BackendAttempt-v2 and both new closed identities with the exact complete current nominal bindings; no historical V1/V2 design fallback by matching schema strings alone.
relations.ServerSubtreeClosure: The worker retains its actual server Popen/process identity and independently qualified native ownership proof for every server descendant/thread in the same original arm group. Successful BackendClosure.group_observation names that exact server subtree, excludes the still-live fixed worker, and records no unresolved server-owned member. The exact native producer is required, not inferred from a wait status or empty child list; unavailable proof makes closure failed/unknown. H later independently requires the entire original arm group empty after worker exit.
relations.WorkerLaunchAck: Actual H-owned original DevelopmentAttempt Popen/identity/group observation only, captured after spawn; exact nonce,request,launch_request,pair,condition,original start and deadlines. Fixed entry waits for this ack before any server spawn; it cannot be a prelaunch input.
